Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X81/X81n1568.xml). Strict Lineage of the Five Lamps (Vols. 10–25) (五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)). Speaker: Cuiyan Kezhen.

Senses.Explanation: The records repeatedly deploy this theatrical pair in formal addresses: the performer carries the stage apparatus and performs when a venue or occasion presents itself. Baichi Xingyuan repeats the pair after a questioner requests a performance and says that, having been firmly asked, he does not dare refuse. Yuan'an Liao speaks it while mounting the ceremonial seat. Baiyu Jingsi raises the whisk and places the pair before a sequence of impossible feats. Cuiyan Kezhen follows it with the statement that one hand cannot clap alone and invites someone from the assembly to come out and join the singing. The performance vocabulary is explicit in the surrounding turns.
